description: This file contains the implementation of a flow component that processes MongoDB bulk write results and sends acknowledgements or failure responses through Akka streams. It manages error counting, logging, and message delivery based on the bulk write outcomes, primarily for internal acknowledgement and error propagation within a distributed system.

classes.name: BulkWriteResultAckFlow
classes.description: A final class responsible for creating and handling an Akka Flow that processes bulk write results, logs outcomes, updates error metrics, and sends responses based on the MongoDB bulk write operation results.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory method to instantiate the flow handler with a provided ActorRef for message sending.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initializes and returns the Akka Flow that processes WriteResultAndErrors objects, applying the checkBulkWriteResult function on each.

methods.name: checkBulkWriteResult
methods.description: Analyzes a WriteResultAndErrors instance to determine if the write was acknowledged, if there are consistency errors, or if individual errors need to be processed. Returns a list of log entries or error messages accordingly.

methods.name: acknowledgeFailures
methods.description: Increments the error counter and sends failure responses for a list of Metadata objects representing failed write items.

methods.name: acknowledge
methods.description: Sends acknowledgment or failure responses for each Metadata item by creating an UpdateThingResponse and wrapping it in a ShardedMessageEnvelope sent via the ActorRef.

methods.name: createFailureResponse
methods.description: Constructs an UpdateThingResponse indicating failure for a given Metadata object.

methods.name: createResponse
methods.description: Builds an UpdateThingResponse with details from a Metadata object, success status, and associated headers.

methods.name: wasNotAcknowledged
methods.description: Checks if the bulk write result was not acknowledged by MongoDB.

methods.name: checkForConsistencyError
methods.description: Verifies whether the bulk write errors correspond with the requested models count, returning an Optional with an error message if a mismatch occurs.

methods.name: areAllIndexesWithinBounds
methods.description: Ensures all error indexes are within the bounds of the write models list.

methods.name: getAllThings
methods.description: Extracts all Metadata objects from the list of write models.

methods.name: logResult
methods.description: Generates a detailed log string for the bulk write result, including success, partial success, or unexpected errors with stack traces.
